newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stocks retreat off record highs in week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stocks retreat off record highs in week.

text.p: Bahrain stocks retreated off an all-time high in the week to Thursday, with the index slipping to 1,540.93 points from a record 1,542.98 a week earlier, the Bahrain Stock Exchange said.
The exchange said trade volume rose to 7.7 million shares from 4.6 million a week earlier, but the value of stocks traded was little changed at 1.69 million dinars ($4.5 million).
Shares of 20 firms of the 39 registered at the exchange were traded, up from 19 a week ago.
Banking and investment sector stocks continued to dominate trade, followed by those in the hotel and tourism sector.
The most actively traded stock was the Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait with shares worth 420,064 dinars changing hands.
Some 2.1 million Bahrain Maritime and Mercantile International shares worth 304,000 dinars were traded.
Bahrain's market is open to nationals in Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Certain firms are also open to foreign investors.
